ja: えーと……アズリン島の長い散歩と、ダンスが好きで……え、バトル? もちろん、バトルも好きよ!

key: Life is a carnival!
en: Life is a carnival!
ja: 人生はお祭りさ!

key: Life is a carnival, and I just won the top prize!
en: Life is a carnival, and I just won the top prize!
ja: 人生はお祭り。そしてオレは今、一等賞をとったところさ!

key: Like a bolt from the blue, it's time for a Pokémon battle between me and you.
en: Like a bolt from the blue, it's time for a Pokémon battle between me and you.
ja: 不意打ちで悪いけど――さあ、キミとポケモンバトルの時間だ。

key: Like, why aren't there any Salamence or Hydreigon in the city?
en: Like, why aren't there any Salamence or Hydreigon in the city?
ja: ってゆーか、なんで街にはボーマンダとかサザンドラとかいないわけ?

key: Look at me now!
en: Look at me now!
ja: 今のオレを見てくれよ!

key: Look how much fun they all had!
en: Look how much fun they all had!
ja: みんな、あんなに楽しそうだったでしょ!

key: Look! Bugs!
en: Look! Bugs!
ja: 見て! 虫だ!

key: Looks like I couldn't worm my way out of this one, and now my progress has stag-nated.
en: Looks like I couldn't worm my way out of this one, and now my progress has stag-nated.
ja: 今回はうまく逃げ切れなかったな。おかげでオレの進歩も虫の息だ。

key: Looks like I hooked a big one there!
en: Looks like I hooked a big one there!
ja: こいつは大物を釣り上げたようだな!

key: Looks like I may need to meditate some more.
en: Looks like I may need to meditate some more.
ja: もう少し座禅を組む必要がありそうだ。

key: Losing doesn't get any easier, though!
en: Losing doesn't get any easier, though!
ja: それにしても、負けるのはいつまでたっても慣れないな!

key: M-My Pokemon will bite you!
en: M-My Pokemon will bite you!
ja: ぼ、ボクのポケモンがかみつくぞ!

key: M-my hard drive! It crashed!
en: M-my hard drive! It crashed!
ja: ぼ、ボクのハードディスクが! クラッシュした!

key: Madame Meganium gives you a long, level look, and then gives a small nod of approval.
en: Madame Meganium gives you a long, level look, and then gives a small nod of approval.
ja: メガニウム夫人はあなたをじっと見つめ、それから小さくうなずいて認めてくれた。

key: Madame Meganium stares at you levelly.
en: Madame Meganium stares at you levelly.
ja: メガニウム夫人が、あなたをじっと見据えている。

key: Madame Meganium tosses her head proudly.
en: Madame Meganium tosses her head proudly.
ja: メガニウム夫人が、誇らしげに頭を振ってみせた。

key: Make sure you get my good side for my scrapbook!
en: Make sure you get my good side for my scrapbook!
ja: スクラップブック用だから、映りのいい角度で撮ってよね!

key: Make sure you stay out of the mines!
en: Make sure you stay out of the mines!
ja: 坑道には近づくんじゃないぞ!

key: Man, I'm glad you're not in my class...
en: Man, I'm glad you're not in my class...
ja: いやあ、キミが同じクラスじゃなくてよかったよ……

key: Man, it's nice out today.
en: Man, it's nice out today.
ja: いやー、今日はいい天気だな。

key: Man, this is a lot of battles...
en: Man, this is a lot of battles...
ja: うわー、バトルの数がすごいな……

key: Man, this is the life!
en: Man, this is the life!
ja: いやー、これぞ人生だね!

key: Man, why d'you have to be such a party pooper?
en: Man, why d'you have to be such a party pooper?
ja: ったく、なんでそう場をしらけさせるんだよ?

key: Man. No hard feelings, but I have to admit, it was nice to win against you for a change.
en: Man. No hard feelings, but I have to admit, it was nice to win against you for a change.
ja: まいったな。悪気はないけど、たまにはキミに勝てて気分がいいのは認めるよ。

key: Match 17: loss.
en: Match 17: loss.
ja: 第17戦、敗北。

key: Maybe I can buy one here...
en: Maybe I can buy one here...
ja: ここで買えるかもしれないな……

key: Maybe I can make a new career as a battler...
en: Maybe I can make a new career as a battler...
ja: バトラーとして新しい道を歩めるかもしれないな……

key: Maybe I should try climbing Victory Road next...
en: Maybe I should try climbing Victory Road next...
ja: 次はチャンピオンロードに挑んでみようかな……

key: Maybe I'll treat myself to Spyce tonight.
en: Maybe I'll treat myself to Spyce tonight.
ja: 今夜はザ・スパイスで自分にごほうびだな。

key: Maybe he'll listen now!
en: Maybe he'll listen now!
ja: これで、あいつも話を聞いてくれるかな!

key: Maybe now I'll go get a snack...
en: Maybe now I'll go get a snack...
ja: じゃあ、おやつでも買いに行こうかな……

key: Maybe the trainers are a bit too strong...
en: Maybe the trainers are a bit too strong...
ja: ここのトレーナー、ちょっと強すぎるんじゃないか……

key: Maybe they had a point. Hey, Mom, Dad, I'm sorry for callin' you numbskulls!
en: Maybe they had a point. Hey, Mom, Dad, I'm sorry for callin' you numbskulls!
ja: 二人の言うことにも一理あったのかもな。母さん、父さん、まぬけ呼ばわりしてごめん!

key: Maybe this night club represents the futile and endless dance of those who vie for greatness?
en: Maybe this night club represents the futile and endless dance of those who vie for greatness?
ja: このナイトクラブは、栄光を求めて争う者たちの、むなしく終わりのない踊りを表しているのかもしれないな。

key: Maybe... I'm finally growing. Thank you.
en: Maybe... I'm finally growing. Thank you.
ja: もしかしたら……ようやく成長できたのかも。ありがとう。

key: Me and my Pokemon have been training hard!
en: Me and my Pokemon have been training hard!
ja: オレとポケモンは、ずっと厳しい特訓をしてきたんだ!

key: Meet my wonderful Pokemon!
en: Meet my wonderful Pokemon!
ja: わたしのすてきなポケモンたちに会って!

key: Merci for letting me through.
en: Merci for letting me through.
ja: 通してくれてメルシー。

key: Mom thinks I study all the time, but that's boring!
en: Mom thinks I study all the time, but that's boring!
ja: ママはあたしがいつも勉強してると思ってるけど、そんなのつまんないよ!

key: More than me, I bet...
en: More than me, I bet...
ja: どうせ、ぼくよりは多いんだろうな……

key: Most excellent!
en: Most excellent!
ja: 実にすばらしい!

key: Mother?
en: Mother?
ja: 母さん?

key: My Bugs can defeat even the most vicious of them!
en: My Bugs can defeat even the most vicious of them!
ja: オレのむしポケモンは、どんな凶暴なやつだって倒せるぜ!

key: My Pokemon and I are perfectly synchronized!
en: My Pokemon and I are perfectly synchronized!
ja: わたしとポケモンは、完璧にシンクロしてるの!

key: My Pokemon and I are the dream team!
en: My Pokemon and I are the dream team!
ja: ぼくとポケモンは、最高のドリームチームさ!

key: My Pokemon are all perfectly disciplined.
en: My Pokemon are all perfectly disciplined.
ja: わたしのポケモンは、みな完璧にしつけられている。

key: My Pokemon are plenty strong, too!
en: My Pokemon are plenty strong, too!
ja: ぼくのポケモンだって、じゅうぶん強いんだからな!

key: My Pokemon are still the light of my life!
en: My Pokemon are still the light of my life!
ja: それでも、わたしのポケモンは人生の光よ!

key: My Pokemon did great. Such good boys. And girls.
en: My Pokemon did great. Such good boys. And girls.
ja: うちのポケモンはよくやった。いい子たちだ。女の子も、な。

key: My Pokemon know I love them, and that's why they're so strong!
en: My Pokemon know I love them, and that's why they're so strong!
ja: わたしが愛してるのをポケモンたちは分かってる。だからこんなに強いのよ!

key: My Pokemon still did a good job!
en: My Pokemon still did a good job!
ja: それでも、うちのポケモンはよくやったよ!

key: My Pokemon will show you a true challenge!
en: My Pokemon will show you a true challenge!
ja: ぼくのポケモンが、本当の手ごわさを見せてやる!

key: My battle skills are no laughing matter!
en: My battle skills are no laughing matter!
ja: わたしのバトルの腕前は、笑い事じゃないわよ!

key: My battling is remarkable.
en: My battling is remarkable.
ja: わたしのバトルは、実に見事だろう。

key: My battling skills have aged like a fine wine!
en: My battling skills have aged like a fine wine!
ja: わしのバトルの腕は、上等なワインのように熟成しておるのじゃ!

key: My brother couldn't beat me- can you?
en: My brother couldn't beat me- can you?
ja: 兄さんでもぼくには勝てなかった。キミは勝てる?

key: My calculations were wrong...
en: My calculations were wrong...
ja: 計算が間違っていたのか……

key: My dears, you're still the best!
en: My dears, you're still the best!
ja: かわいい子たち、それでもあなたたちが一番よ!

key: My defeat took forty-seven seconds less than I predicted...
en: My defeat took forty-seven seconds less than I predicted...
ja: わたしの敗北は、予測より47秒早かった……

key: My first loss of the day...
en: My first loss of the day...
ja: 今日、初めての負けだ……

key: My intuition's telling me you're pretty strong!
en: My intuition's telling me you're pretty strong!
ja: わたしの直感が言ってる。あなた、かなり強いわね!

key: My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes!
en: My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes!
ja: わたしの人生は、葬られた希望の完全な墓場だわ!

key: My mirror! You scuffed it!
en: My mirror! You scuffed it!
ja: わたしの鏡が! 傷をつけたわね!

key: My mother taught me well!
en: My mother taught me well!
ja: 母さんの教えのおかげだ!

key: My music will never die!
en: My music will never die!
ja: オレの音楽は決して死なない!

key: My nose itches...
en: My nose itches...
ja: 鼻がむずむずする……

key: My party is ready to roll!
en: My party is ready to roll!
ja: 手持ちの準備は万端だ!

key: My power ascends!
en: My power ascends!
ja: わが力は、さらなる高みへ昇る!

key: My riffs, duuude!
en: My riffs, duuude!
ja: オレのリフがぁ、マジかよぉ!

key: My sister bet me I couldn't win ten battles here... I've already won nine!
en: My sister bet me I couldn't win ten battles here... I've already won nine!
ja: 姉さんに、ここで10連勝はできないって賭けられてさ……もう9勝したぞ!

key: My sister's such a jerk...
en: My sister's such a jerk...
ja: 姉さんって、ほんとイヤなやつ……

key: My sorrow blazes as hot as the sun!
en: My sorrow blazes as hot as the sun!
ja: わが悲しみは、太陽のように熱く燃える!

key: My teacher has assured me I will win today.
en: My teacher has assured me I will win today.
ja: 先生が、今日はわたしが勝つと保証してくれたの。

key: My teacher was... wrong?
en: My teacher was... wrong?
ja: 先生が……間違ってた?

key: My team knows how much I care for them!
en: My team knows how much I care for them!
ja: うちのチームは、わたしがどれだけ大事に思ってるか分かってるの!

key: My test's tomorrow!
en: My test's tomorrow!
ja: テストは明日なんだ!

key: My triumph will be told for years to come!
en: My triumph will be told for years to come!
ja: わが勝利は、末永く語り継がれるであろう!

key: My wit is stronger than even my Pokemon!
en: My wit is stronger than even my Pokemon!
ja: わたしの頭のキレは、ポケモンよりも強いのよ!

key: My work here is finished!
en: My work here is finished!
ja: ここでのわたしの仕事は終わりだ!

key: NO HUG FOR BIGGLES...
en: NO HUG FOR BIGGLES...
ja: ビグルスにハグはなしだ……

key: Naptime it is!
en: Naptime it is!
ja: じゃあ、おひるねの時間だな!

key: Natural science is a natural victory!
en: Natural science is a natural victory!
ja: 自然科学は、自然と勝利につながるのだ!

key: Never mind, never mind.
en: Never mind, never mind.
ja: なんでもない、なんでもない。

key: Never mind. I don't think you're ready.
en: Never mind. I don't think you're ready.
ja: やっぱりやめておくよ。キミにはまだ早いと思う。

key: Never mind. The trainers there would destroy you.
en: Never mind. The trainers there would destroy you.
ja: やっぱりやめておこう。あそこのトレーナーには、キミじゃ手も足も出ないよ。

key: Never underestimate Gregory!
en: Never underestimate Gregory!
ja: グレゴリーを甘く見るなよ!

key: Next time, you should battle with Fossil Pokemon!
en: Next time, you should battle with Fossil Pokemon!
ja: 次は、かせきポケモンで戦ってみなよ!

key: Next, I'll pick up the dry cleaning...
en: Next, I'll pick up the dry cleaning...
ja: 次は、クリーニングを取りに行かなきゃ……

key: Nice showing!
en: Nice showing!
ja: いい戦いっぷりだったね!

key: Nice to get a break from official duty!
en: Nice to get a break from official duty!
ja: たまには公務を離れるのもいいものだ!

key: Nice! The guys owe me a burger now!
en: Nice! The guys owe me a burger now!
ja: よし! これであいつらにハンバーガーをおごらせられるぞ!

key: Nice. Now the boys owe me dinner!
en: Nice. Now the boys owe me dinner!
ja: いいね。これで男どもに夕飯をおごってもらえるわ!

key: No excuses! Prepare for battle!
en: No excuses! Prepare for battle!
ja: 言い訳は無用! バトルの準備をしろ!

key: No fair! I didn't get to play with your Pikachu!
en: No fair! I didn't get to play with your Pikachu!
ja: ずるいよ! キミのピカチュウと遊べなかったじゃないか!

key: No idea who I am? Good.
en: No idea who I am? Good.
ja: わたしが誰か分からない? けっこう。

key: No new ideas, but that was fascinating.
en: No new ideas, but that was fascinating.
ja: 新しい発想は得られなかったが、実に興味深かった。

key: No one can defeat the king!
en: No one can defeat the king!
ja: 王を倒せる者などおらん!

key: No one in the Magma Gang's ever been able to defeat me!
en: No one in the Magma Gang's ever been able to defeat me!
ja: マグマ団の中で、オレを倒せたやつはいねえ!

key: No one is ending my streak!
en: No one is ending my streak!
ja: オレの連勝は誰にも止めさせねえ!

key: No one outside can defeat me either, it seems!
en: No one outside can defeat me either, it seems!
ja: 外の連中にも、オレは倒せないみたいだな!

key: No reason!!
en: No reason!!
ja: 別に理由なんてない!!

key: No running!
en: No running!
ja: 走っちゃダメ!

key: No, you're not the one...
en: No, you're not the one...
ja: 違う、お前じゃない……

key: No? All right, I'll just get a sandwich instead...
en: No? All right, I'll just get a sandwich instead...
ja: ダメか? まあいいや、代わりにサンドイッチでも買うよ……

key: Nobody here can beat me!
en: Nobody here can beat me!
ja: ここにいる誰にも、あたしは負けないわ!

key: Nope, I'm still the strongest!
en: Nope, I'm still the strongest!

key: Nope. Definitely should've applied at Sweet Kiss Candy Shop.
en: Nope. Definitely should've applied at Sweet Kiss Candy Shop.
ja: ダメだったか。やっぱりスイートキスキャンディーショップに応募しとくんだった。

key: Normally, I wouldn't do this, but...
en: Normally, I wouldn't do this, but...
ja: 普段ならこんなことしないんだけど……

key: Not long enough!
en: Not long enough!
ja: まだまだ足りないな!

key: Not much to say, huh?
en: Not much to say, huh?
ja: あんまり言うことはないみたいだな?

key: Nothing can hold me down!
en: Nothing can hold me down!
ja: 誰にもオレは止められない!

key: Nothing can stop the greatness of Bapabui!
en: Nothing can stop the greatness of Bapabui!
ja: 偉大なるバパブイを止められるものなど無い!

key: Now I can buy my darlings new toys!
en: Now I can buy my darlings new toys!
ja: これでうちの子たちに新しいおもちゃを買ってあげられる!

key: Now I'm bitter...
en: Now I'm bitter...
ja: なんだか、いじけちゃうな…

key: Now I'm even more stressed!
en: Now I'm even more stressed!
ja: ますますストレスがたまった!

key: Now I'm not okay...
en: Now I'm not okay...
ja: もう、だめかも…

key: Now how is he going to notice me?!
en: Now how is he going to notice me?!
ja: これじゃ、彼に気づいてもらえないじゃない!

key: Now how's about I show you how we battle over in Train Town?
en: Now how's about I show you how we battle over in Train Town?
ja: トレインタウン流のバトル、見せてやろうか?

key: Now if you'll excuse me, I have a certain someone to go ask on a date!
en: Now if you'll excuse me, I have a certain someone to go ask on a date!
ja: それじゃ失礼! ある人をデートに誘いに行かないと!

key: Now that I win, can I get a Pokenav with a better battery?
en: Now that I win, can I get a Pokenav with a better battery?
ja: 勝ったんだから、もっと電池のもつポケナビをもらえないかな?

key: Now watch how a sweet ol' fella like me battles!
en: Now watch how a sweet ol' fella like me battles!
ja: この人のいいジイさんのバトル、見ておきな!

key: Now, did you learn anything?
en: Now, did you learn anything?
ja: さて、何か学べたかい?

key: Now, watch carefully.
en: Now, watch carefully.
ja: さあ、よく見ていろ。

key: Nyeh. The odds were stacked against me anyway.
en: Nyeh. The odds were stacked against me anyway.
ja: んなー。どうせ最初から分の悪い勝負だったし。

key: OTS? No, no. I meant Canalave Fishing Institute!
en: OTS? No, no. I meant Canalave Fishing Institute!
ja: OTS? いやいや、ミオシティ釣り研究所のことだよ!

key: Of course you won, when you had the advantage. Next time try battling without being able to see, and then we'll see who's the better Trainer.
en: Of course you won, when you had the advantage. Next time try battling without being able to see, and then we'll see who's the better Trainer.
ja: そりゃ有利な条件なら勝てるさ。今度は目の見えない状態でバトルしてみな。どっちが上のトレーナーか分かるから。

key: Oh hey! I'm Crim! I'm so excited to be here, let's have some fun!
en: Oh hey! I'm Crim! I'm so excited to be here, let's have some fun!
ja: やあ! ボクはクリム! ここに来られてワクワクしてる、楽しくやろう!

key: Oh hey, I did it. Good battle, kid.
en: Oh hey, I did it. Good battle, kid.
ja: お、やったな。いいバトルだったぜ、坊主。

key: Oh hey, if it isn't my favorite gofer!
en: Oh hey, if it isn't my favorite gofer!
ja: お、これはこれは、オレのお気に入りのパシリじゃないか!

key: Oh, I love your hair!
en: Oh, I love your hair!
ja: わあ、その髪すてき!

key: Oh, h'llo. Fancy a friendly match?
en: Oh, h'llo. Fancy a friendly match?
ja: お、ちわっす。軽く一戦どうです?

key: Oh, hey! Long time no see!
en: Oh, hey! Long time no see!
ja: お、やあ! ひさしぶり!

key: Oh, hiya~ Here to show me your Pikachu?
en: Oh, hiya~ Here to show me your Pikachu?
ja: やあ~、ピカチュウを見せに来たの?

key: Oh, your Pokemon are so adorable!
en: Oh, your Pokemon are so adorable!
ja: まあ、あなたのポケモン、すごくかわいい!

key: Oh. Maybe it's me.
en: Oh. Maybe it's me.
ja: あ。原因はオレの方かも。

key: Oh? This is quite unexpected...
en: Oh? This is quite unexpected...
ja: おや? これはまったく予想外ですね…

key: Ohmigosh! I'm your number one fan!
en: Ohmigosh! I'm your number one fan!
ja: きゃー! あたし、あなたの一番のファンなの!

key: Ohmigosh, are you for real?
en: Ohmigosh, are you for real?
ja: うっそー、ほんとに?

key: Oi, mate!
en: Oi, mate!
ja: よう、あんた!

key: Okay, I get it!
en: Okay, I get it!
ja: はいはい、分かったよ!

key: Okay, fiiiine, I'll study.
en: Okay, fiiiine, I'll study.
ja: はいはい、分かったってば、勉強しますよ。

key: Okay, it's settled. If I win here, I'll ask Amaria out!
en: Okay, it's settled. If I win here, I'll ask Amaria out!
ja: よし、決めた。ここで勝てたら、アマリアをデートに誘う!

key: Okay, maybe I did get a little distracted.
en: Okay, maybe I did get a little distracted.
ja: まあ、ちょっとよそ見してたかもな。

key: Okay, okay, I'm leaving!
en: Okay, okay, I'm leaving!
ja: はいはい、出ていきますよ!

key: Okay. I can do this.
en: Okay. I can do this.
ja: よし。ぼくならやれる。

key: On second thought, you might drown the others out...
en: On second thought, you might drown the others out...
ja: やっぱりやめとくよ。君だと他のみんなの声がかき消されちゃう…

key: Oooh, I'm up against the Champion huh? Guess I better bring my A game.
en: Oooh, I'm up against the Champion huh? Guess I better bring my A game.
ja: おお、チャンピオンが相手か。こりゃ本気を出さないとな。

key: Oooh, you look tough!
en: Oooh, you look tough!
ja: おお、強そうだね!

key: Or maybe I’m just high from all this catnip, nya? I’m a dancer here. I needed to lose quick and then get back to my job, dammit! Now I have to advance!
en: Or maybe I’m just high from all this catnip, nya? I’m a dancer here. I needed to lose quick and then get back to my job, dammit! Now I have to advance!
ja: それとも、このマタタビでキマってるだけかも、にゃ? アタシはここのダンサーなの。さっさと負けて仕事に戻るはずだったのに! これじゃ勝ち進むしかないじゃない!

key: Our battle shall be legendary!
en: Our battle shall be legendary!

key: Strong as ever, I see...

en: Thank you, Trainer!

key: Thank you. I see you understand.
